Artistic & Bold: You hate "easy" stuff and make bold visual choices. - 
Technical & Raw: You know your way around a camera and edit suite, but keep the perspective real. - 
Communicative: You have a high proficiency in both Dutch and English. - 
You're available for a period of 5 months.
